purpose: Define evidence, perspective and calibration rules for the BJJ knowledge graph before reducer integration.

perspective_model.rule: Every edge must state the actor role before and after the transition. A sweep cannot teleport from bottom guard to mount unless the authored technique explicitly includes and justifies that additional positional transition.

success_model.rule: Numeric authoring priors may seed design review but must never be presented as observed success rates. F3 may populate empirical_success; F4 may tune gameplay utility separately.

scoring_model.rule: Scoring belongs to the rules engine and match state, not to a static technique tuple alone.

legality_model.rule: Heel hooks, kneebars, toe holds and other restricted techniques require a legality matrix; gi/nogi booleans alone are not enough.

counter_model.rule: A counter reference must specify whether it denies, redirects, reverses, submits or returns to scramble; an ID list alone is not executable semantics.

chain_model.rule: For adjacent steps A and B, A.to must be compatible with B.from after actor-role normalization.
